description_en: Standing west of the street at the Tyaṅghaḥ Ṭola and facing south, the two-tiered Tyaṅgha Gaṇeśa Mandira houses a four-armed stone statue of Gaṇeśa inside its sanctum. The statue and the woodentoraṇaon its top have received a cover of brass sheets. The door to the sanctum is flanked by a pair of lions and shrews, the animal mount (vāhana) of Gaṇeśa. Akalaśa-shaped finial is placed on top of the two tiers of copper.Tyaṅgha Gaṇeśa is the area deity of the Tyaṅghala Ṭola and is worshipped as a reliever of ailments in children. Therefore, he is also known as Bālakaṣṭa Vināyaka (lit. remover of child ailments).Two inscriptions set against the wall west of the main entrance of the Temple are already unreadable.Pruscha(1975, p.19) mentions the Temple to be constructed in 1679 CE (VS 1622) without referring to any sources. He probably got the information from one of the two unreadable inscriptions that perhaps were readable back then. He also mentions that the Temple was renovated in 1939 CE (VS 1996), which is corroborated by the inscription on the eaves fascia of the lower roof.
description_ne: यो त्यङ्घः टोलको स्थानगणेश हो । विशेषगरी बाल-बालिकाको रक्षा र रोगबाट मुक्त गर्ने गणेशको रूपमा पुजिने हुनाले यिनलाई बालकष्ट विनायक पनि भनिन्छ ।त्यङ्घः टोलको मूल सडकको पश्चिम किनारामा अवस्थित यो गणेश मन्दिर दुई तलाको तले शैलीमा बनेको छ । दक्षिणाभिमुख मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा ढुंगाको गणेश मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । ढुंगाको गणेश मूर्ति र मूर्तिमाथिको काठको तोरणलाई पितलले मोडिएको छ । मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँबायाँ एक-एक जोडी सिंह र गणेशको वाहन छुचुन्द्रो द्वारपालको रूपमा राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको दुबै छानामा तामाको पाता राखिएको छ भने माथिल्लो छानामाथि धातुको गजूर चढाइएको छ ।प्रवेशद्वारको पश्चिममा रहेका दुईवटा अभिलेखहरू जीर्ण भइसकेकाले तिनका विषयवस्तु स्पष्ट छैन ।Pruscha(1975, p.19) लाई आधार मान्ने हो भने यो मन्दिरको निर्माण विसं १६२२ (सन् १६७९) मा भएको थियो । तर उनले कुनै स्रोत नखुलाए पनि मन्दिर बाहिर रहेका यी अभिलेखलाई स्रोत मानेको हुनसक्छ । उनले मन्दिरको जीर्णोद्धार सन् १९३९ मा भएको भनी उल्लेख गरेका छन् जुन मन्दिरको तल्लो छानाको म्हुरःपौमा रहेको अभिलेखले पनि पुष्टि गरेको छ ।टोलको महर्जन खलकले मन्दिरमा नित्यपूजा गर्ने गर्दछन् । हाल उक्त महर्जन खलकमा २९ जनाको परिवार रहेको छ । द्यःपाःलाःको समय अवधि एक वर्षको हुने गर्दछ । घोडे जात्राका दिन द्यःपाःलाः परिवर्तन हुने परम्परा रहँदै आएको छ । घोडे जात्राको भोली अर्थात् चैत्र शुक्ल प्रतिपदाका दिन यस गणेशको धातुको मूर्ति खटमा राखी जात्रा गरिन्छ । मन्दिरको द्यःपाःलाः र स्थानीय मिलेर जात्राको व्यवस्थापन गर्ने गरिन्छ । उक्त धातुको मूर्तिलाई त्यङ्घः टोलमा रहेको द्यःछेँमा राख्ने गरिन्छ भने हरेक हप्ताको मंगलबार उक्त मूर्तिलाई मन्दिरमा ल्याई भक्तजनहरूलाई दर्शन गराइन्छ । यो गणेशको अर्को एउटा धातुको मूर्ति पनि रहेको छ जुन मूर्तिलाई प्रत्येक वर्ष बाला चःह्रय्‌का दिन मात्र मन्दिरमा ल्याई पूजा गरिन्छ (caretaker of the shrine, Maharjana, male, age 45) ।

historical_events.event_description: Pruscha (1975, p.19) mentions that the temple was constructed in 1679 CE. However, he does not refer to any sources (see ‘description’ above for more information).
The inscription embossed on the eaves fascia of the lower roof from VS 1996 informs us that the Temple was renovated in 1939 CE.
Prakāśaratna Mānandhara, Renukā, Pratibhā, Pratimā, and Pralitā jointly offered amaṇḍalāto Gaṇesa.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of copper sheets for the maintenance of the temple
historical_events.event_description: The inscription records only the date of this event. According to the caretaker of the temple, a local resident had offered copper sheets to repair the roof of the temple.
A person named Mohana Ḍhevāju and his wife Saritā offered the bronze bell to Gaṇeśa in memory of his parents Jhalaka Bahādura and Bhima Māyā Ḍhevāju.
A Tāmrākāra family offered thepatāḥto the temple in 2007 CE (VS 2064). Since the inscription is not legible, the name(s) of the family remain obscure.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of brass repousse on wooden toraṇa
historical_events.event_description: On the brass inscription, only the name and address (Vimalā Vaidya, VS 2067/06/21) are mentioned. According to thedyaḥpāḥlāḥ, it is the record of brass repousse on the woodentoraṇaof the sanctum.
A person named Candramāna and his wife Saritā Maharjana, the son and daughter-in-law of Cakrapāna and Satyadevī Maharjana offered the brass repousse of Gaṇeśa.

historical_events.event_name: Repousse the statue of the Gaṇeśa with brass
historical_events.event_description: Candramān and Saritā Maharjana, the son and daughter-in-law of Cakrapāna and Satyadevī Maharjana have offered the repousse of brass on the statue of the Gaṇeśa.
The caretakes of the Temple Candramāna and Saritā Maharjana jointly renovated the stone statue of the Bhagavatī statue.
The son of Macākāji and Maṃgalamāyā, Nilakaṇṭha had done the repousse on the stone lion of the sanctum.

historical_events.event_name: Beautifying and placing tiles in the Mandira
historical_events.event_description: The dyaḥpāla, Puṣpa Ratna Maharjana had beautified by placing tiles inside the Mandira.
